pages.meta_title: Rajaji National Park - Jungle Safari booking - Haridwar Tourism
pages.meta_description: Rajaji National Park is a Tiger Reserved Park in Haridwar Tourism, Uttarakhand. This Park is located in the foothills of the Shivalik Range of the Himalayas.
pages.meta_keywords: Rajaji National Park, Tiger Reserved Park in Uttarakhnad, Jeep Safari, Jungle Safari, Best Time to Visit, Haridwar Tourism
pages.excerpt: Rajaji National Park has total area of 820 square kms. Park is located in Dehradun, Haridwar and Pauri Garhwal districts. River Ganga is also important part of the Rajaji National Park.
pages.body:
Rajaji National Park or Raja Tiger Reserved was established in 1983. This National Park was issued after merging 4 wildlife sanctuaries of Uttarakhand and a small part of Uttar Pradesh. Name Of the sanctuaries Rajaji, Motichur, Ranipur& Chila. Do you know that this was named after one of the famous freedom fighters Lt. Shri C.Rajgopalachari? The total area of the Raja Tiger Reserve is 820 Km. Approximately 255 Sq. Km. The area was merged as the buffer zone of Rajaji National Park in 2015 under the Act of 1972 FOREST WILDLIFE PROTECTION, Now the total area of the Raja Ji Tiger Reserved is 1075 Sq. Kms. Raja Ji National Park Provides clean & fresh air and helps us maintain a green environmental balance in Uttarakhand. It touched three boundaries of Uttarakhand district Dehradun, Scared City of Haridwar & Rishikesh, the capital city of yoga.

Major Attraction of Rajaji National Park

With its picturesque beauty and rich biodiversity, the Tiger Reserve serves as a major attraction for nature lovers and wildlife enthusiasts. The Rajaji Tiger Reserve is located in the hills and foothills of the Shivalik Range and represents the Shivalik ecosystem. The region is covered with a variety of forests ranging from semi-evergreen to deciduous and mixed broadleaf to lowland grassland and is classified as an Indus-Gangetic monsoon forest type. Most parts of Rajaji Tiger Reserve are dominated by Sal trees (Shorea robusta). Its location in a transition zone between the temperate western Himalayas and the central Himalayas increases the diversity of species and consequently the chances of sighting. Jungle Safari is the best option to explore the Rajaji national Park.

Wildlife and Animals in Rajaji National Park

The Rajaji Tiger Reserve has a large population of tigers and Asian elephants. It is home to a variety of wild animals such as leopards, wild cats, Himalayan black bears, sloth bears, striped hyenas, goral, sambar, wild boar, spotted deer, barking deer, and many more. The Tiger Reserve supports a rich habitat of vultures, woodpeckers, hornbills, and various migratory birds like Ruddy Shelduck, Larger Cormorant, Red Created Pochard, Mallard Duck, etc. About 42 species of fish breed in the aquatic habitat supported by rivers, and streams passing through the Tiger Reserve. It also supports a rich habitat of various reptiles like King Cobra, Burmese Python, Common Krait, etc.

Rajaji National Park Weather

October month to February is winter season at Rajaji National park. Temperature is between 8 C to 15 C. Atmosphere is cold and you will get opportunity to see birds like White Capped, Plumbeous Redstarts and Himalayan and Pied Kingfisher.

March to April month is spring season in Rajaji National Park. Climate is amazing and this is best time to visit here. Temperature is between 15 C to 25 C. May to June month is summer season here. During summer you will get good chances to view wild animals because they have to come at river for water many time.

July to September month is monsoon season here. Park in normally closed during monsoon. Whole area looks green and landscape looks wonderful.

Safari Zone - Chilla Forest Zone

Chilla Forest Range is only allowed the open jeep run by the local people and a small Interpretation Center-Cum-Library. The Chilla Range safari covers approx 30 km circuit that will take around 2hrs to 03hrs. During this safari, we cover 03 internal checkposts of the forest Mundal, Mithawali, and Khara. During the Safari you can enjoy the natural beauty of the forest, beautiful landscapes, or the sight of various wild animals like tigers, leopards, and elephants. Mundal and Ghasiram's machans give you the opportunity of a gorgeous 360-degree view of the forest.

Flora

The flora in Rajaji Tiger Reserve is nestled between the Indo-Gangetic plains and the Shivalik ranges and the riverine vegetation, broadleaf deciduous forests, grasslands, clear lands, and deodar forests form the diversity of greenery in these parks. The lush green forests in this park / save are home to energetic and indomitable life. Some of the famous flora found in this park include Amaltas (Cassia fistula) Rohini (Mallotusphilippensis) Palash (Butea monosperma) Sheesham (Dalbergia sissoo) Sal (Shorea robusta) Sandon (Eugenia oogenesis) Khair (Acacia) Catechu) Arjun (Terminalia arjuna) Bamboo (Dendrocalamusstrictus) Semul (Bombax ceiba) Chamor (Ehretia laevis) Amla (Emblica officinalis) Ber (Ziziphus mauritiana) Chila (Kesaria tomentosa) Bel (Aegle marmelos) Kachnar (Bauhinia variegata) etc.

Fauna

Among the fauna of Rajaji Tiger Reserve, the number of elephants and tigers is more. Different types of wild animals include Wilderness feline, panther, goral, striped hyena, Himalayan mountain bear, sloth bear, jackal, woofing deer, sambar, and wild boar, in addition, there are also some primates which include Hanuman langur, Indian langur. and the rhesus macaque. Small warm-blooded animals that are mostly found in the park are the Indian hare and the Indian porcupine. Reptiles in Rajaji include the (Indian) cobra, lord cobra, python, common kurta, and screen reptile.

There are about 315 bird species that give guests a major visual gift. The public bird peacock has been tracked down in the overflow. A large number of butterflies and small birds are also seen which adorn this place. Some types of birds include motor-mouth, corroded cheek scimitar, chestnut-followed starling, brilliant spectacled songbird, Drago cuckoo, mud-colored falcon owl, incredible hornbill, sharp-headed parrot, red wilderness fowl, peaked kingfisher, lineated barbet, dark hooded. Orioles, finches, khaleej birds, thrushes, and some others. To get excited and encounter the grandeur of the forest and the species, one has to visit this place and check out the Shivalik and Himalayan regions at Rajaji Tiger Save.

Rajaji National Park Entrance Fees and jungle safari booking

Entry fees for Indian Visitor - Rs. 150.00 per person for 03 hour Jungle Safari at Chilla Range. Entry fees for Foreign Visitor - Rs. 600.00 per person for 03 hour Jungle Safari at Chilla Range. Additional camera fee - Rs.50 for foreigners. Movie camera fees are extra.

Rajaji National Park Jungle Safari

Wildlife Jungle Safari at Rajaji National Park can be done between 15th November and 15th June every year. Total 33 kms drive in jeep passes through thick forest and lush green areas. The Jeep safari at Rajaji National Park provides opportunity to see peacocks, groups of spotted deer or cheetal, monkeys, Sambhar, Elephant and many other animals and birds. Jungle Safari or Jeep Safari is open in two ranges. Chilla Range and Motichur Range

Rajaji National Park Safari Timings

There are two time schedules. Morning 06:00 AM to 10:00 AM is first safari and second safari time is 02:00 PM to 06:00 PM.

Rajaji National Park Safari Rules

Avoid bright color cloths. Keep silence for better chance to view animals. Shouting, teasing and chasing animals is prohibited. Do not get down from your jeep except designated points. Plastic is prohibited in park.

How to reach Rajaji National Park, Haridwar

Tourists can enjoy wildlife safari in 05 zones/ranges by taking a jeep safari. All the gates are well connected by road and tourists can book a safari from the respective gate. Rajaji Tiger Reserve can be reached by road from Delhi, Meerut, Roorkee, Haridwar, Rishikesh, Mussoorie, Dehradun, Nainital, Bijnor and Chandigarh. The nearest railway headquarters are located at Haridwar, Rishikesh, and Dehradun and the nearest airport is Jolly Grant (Dehradun). You can go by car or take a train to Haridwar, Rishikesh and Dehradun. There are many flights available from Delhi and other Indian cities.

By Road

  • Jolly Grant to Chilla - 40 KM
  • Dehradun to Chilla - 55 KM
  • Delhi to Chilla - 224 KM
  • Distance from Other Places
  • Delhi to Chilla Range distance - 224 via NH 334

By Train

Nearest Railway Station from Chilla is Haridwar. (The distance from Railway Station from Chilla is 5 Kms)

By Air

Nearest Airport from Chilla is Dehradun. (The distance from Dehradun to kotdwar is 40 Kms)

Do and Don't

  • Kindly enter the recreation area solely after taking the fundamental allows and adhering to every one of the guidelines.
  • If it's not too much trouble, profit from the administrations of nature guides who have been prepared by the recreation area for your advantage. They help you a ton in watching the untamed life and ensuring that you remember your direction in the woods.
  • Pass gradually through the recreation area. This way you can see, notice, and partake in the natural life to the most extreme, without upsetting it.
  • Remain on assigned streets and trails. Driving off the track can make you stomp on over-developing trees and upset resting creatures and their young.
  • Regard wild creatures and stay away from them. Keep in mind, that you are in their home and they get the main goal.
  • Pay attention to the music of the woods rather than your vehicle sound system or semiconductor. The calmer you are, the more probable you are to see untamed life. Wear light-shaded garments. Brilliant varieties make most wild creatures restless and they take off.
  • Try not to convey weapons. Go ahead and shoot with a camera all things being equal.
  • Try not to smoke or light pit fires in the forest. Unintentional fire can obliterate this awesome timberland in a matter of moments.
  • Try not to escape your vehicle at any spot in the recreation area with the exception of where allowed. This is for your own well-being and the security of the untamed life.
  • The recreation area isn't a zoo; So don't anticipate seeing natural life all over. Rajaji is likewise beguiling in his scenes.
  • Try not to be disheartened on the off chance that you don't see a tiger. There are numerous other fascinating animals that ought to be seen and valued.
  • Liquor and non-veggie lover food are not permitted.
  • Assist with keeping the recreation area contamination-free. While inside the recreation area, if it's not too much trouble, put your whole non-biodegradable waste (metal jars, plastic, glass bottles, metal foil, and so on) in the given sack and discard it while going out.

Rishikesh is an attractive small town be situated in the foothills of the Indian Himalayas and famous the world over for its annual yoga festival. There are lots of temples as well as ashrams in Rishikesh where traveler continuously visits.

Rishikesh is global famous for its Yoga and Meditation ashrams. The ashrams in Rishikesh generate an unparalled sense of ascetism. Rishikesh Ashrams take in name only fees from pilgrims for accommodation and gives very normal services.

Rishikesh is a small city in the northern state of Uttarakhand in India. Scenically positioned where the Ganges River comes downward from the Himalayas, Rishikesh catapulted to Western fame when the Beatles dropped by for a visit to Maharishi Mahesh Yoga Rishikesh Ashrams, and the town is still identified as the World Capital of Yoga.

A Brief List Ashrams in Rishikesh, and Rishikesh Yoga Ashrams is Given Below

Parmarth Niketan Ashram : Parmarth Niketan is positioned near Swargashram. Its president is Swami Chidanand Saraswatiji Maharaj. Ganga Aarti performed here every evening is worth watching and calms down ones senses and mind. There is also a Gurukul (a school) run by ashram for teaching Yoga, Meditation and other Hindu sacred ceremonies. 'International Yoga Festival' is organized by ashram every year in the month of February, in which people from all over the world participate.

Yoga Niketan Ashram : Yoga Niketan Trust was foundecd by Swami Yogeshwaranand Paramahans. Little bit above the main Badrinath road completely free from noise or pollution and full of greenery throughout. Yoga Hall cum Samadhi hall is exclusively used morning and evening for Asanas and Pranayams, Kriyas are done once a week and there is a big platform outside the hall for the same. Sadhna Hall or the meditation hall, has got room cooler as well as air conditioner for the comfort of the students, to enable them to practice meditation quite comfortably.

Dayananda Ashram : Swami Dayananda Ashram is sited in the banks of Ganges. This ashram is a place to take recluse from the stress and strain of everyday life. A panorama of scenic beauty is available from this ashram. It has been a center for teaching Sanskrit and Vedic learning. Ashram is a spiritually focused center to bring the arts of Iyengar yoga, Vedanta, Meditation, and Sanskrit studies to any people who may be seeking these knowledge.

Madhuban Ashram : Madhuban Ashram is to be found at Kailash Gate, Muni-ki-Reti, Rishikesh. Is the centre of Vaishnav bhakti in the whole Uttarakhand region and beyond. Vaishnav devotees from all over India are associated with the Ashram.

Beatles Ashram : Rishikesh the 'World's capital of Yoga' is also famous as the spot where the Beatles wrote their popular White Album. Back in the days they stayed in the ashram of Guru Maharishi Mahesh Yogi. Beatles Ashram is now a deserted, pillaged spot but it's still possible to imagine it full of life and spirit. We were guided through the ruins by a money-hungry saddhu that helped us to bushwhack through the enormous complex. When it was still running it housed up to 8000 spiritual seekers and had a bank, post office, school etc.

Sivananda Ashram : Sivananda Ashram is positioned on the banks of the holy river Ganges at the foothills of the Himalayan ranges. Swami Sivananda established this ashram with a sacred thought of promoting spiritualism and of providing the spiritual practice for devotees. Many charitable and spiritual activities are conducted under the auspices of the Ashram, they include Yoga-Vedanta Forest Academy, Sivananda Eye Hospital and Sivananda Ayurvedic Pharmacy. Yoga classes are conducted every day for the public in the Ashram.

Omkarananda Ashram : Omkarananda Ashram, run by a group of Sanyasis (sages) and to be found at a place Muni-Ke-Reti the bank of river Ganges, is established long back in 1967. The Ashram is under the dynamic leadership of Shri. Omkarananda, a recipient of many awards and is engaged in many social activities for the accomplishment of spiritual and physical well being of the society. The activities are mostly in the fields of cultural, social, religious and educational.

pages.body:
Rishikesh is one of the most holy cities in India. It is to be found in the Dehradun district of Uttarakhand. Rishikesh Tourism sightseeing includes visiting famous the places in and around Rishikesh.

Holy city of Rishikesh in Uttarakhand is home to various tourist attractions. A place where divinity and nature combine and give the choicest of experiences, it seeks to be a perfect abode for people seeking piety, tranquility and wisdom. Rishikesh is the ideal base camp for exploring the majesty of the mountains and conquering the torrents of the river. Spiritual pursuits and adventurous tourism quests form an important part of its traveler influx. Listed below are some places to be included in sightseeing tours of Rishikesh.

There is no dearth of things to do and places to see in Rishikesh. One can opt for an action packed holiday or select to do nothing. Rishikesh is a magnificent place for those who want to learn yoga. Adventure seekers love it for the rafting and trekking breaks that the destination offers.

Following are the Tourist Attractions of Rishikesh

Triveni Ghat : o be found in the heart of town, is the most famous bathing ghat, where most pilgrims take a holy dip earlier than they visit the various temples. This is done generally in the early mornings, with the pilgrims offering prayers and milk at the Ghat and feeding the fish in the water. An amazing sight here is the evening arati, a ceremony accompanied by lights, drums and chanting, with the entire ghat lit with lamps glowing from a distance.

Bharat Mandir : Near the Ghat, is the temple known as Bharat Mandir said to be the oldest temple here built by the Adi Shankaracharya. This 9th century temple has the deity of Lord Vishnu carved out of a single black stone popular as Shaligram, and is placed in the inner chambers of the temple. The original temple was said to have been destroyed in 1398 AD. If you are lucky, catch the spring festival also called Basant Panchami celebrated here.

Rishikund : Close to the Triveni Ghat is the very old place of Rishikund where the Saint Kubz is said to have been blessed by the Goddess Yamuna, who filled the pond with her water. The temple of Raghunath dedicated to Lord Rama and his wife Sita is sited here.

Lakshman Jhula : 2 kilometers from Swarg Ashram, is the well-known Lakshman Jhula a suspension bridge 450 feet long and built in 1939. Named after Lord Ram's younger brother Lakshman, it has temples dotting its either side, including the famed Lakshman Temple at Tapovan. One more noteworthy ashram is the 13 storeyed Kailashananda Ashram, with each storey being dedicated to a different deity.

Ram Jhula : Ramjhula is situated 3Km north of Rishikesh. It's a very popular place amongst people coming for religious purposes because it has very known Ashrams. Most known is Geeta Bhavan & Swarg Ashram and these temples are very important in Hindu society and you will see much more commotion here then in Lakshmanjhula.

Neelkanth Mahadev Temple : To be found at a distance of 12 km from Rishikesh, this temple stands at a height of 926m on top of a hill across the river Ganga. It derives its name from Lord Shiva. According to mythological belief; the cosmic churning of the oceans (Sagar Manthan) for the potion of immortality (amrit) by the Gods and the Demons; produced a venomous liquid, which was consumed by Lord Shiva at this place. As a result, his throat became blue in color, which in Hindi literally means 'Neelkanth' (blue throat). The place is a favorite among the religious tourists.

Swarga Ashram : There is a cluster of ashrams on the eastern bank of the Ganges, and the place is popularly known as 'Swarga Ashram'. Most of these ashrams provide courses on yoga and spiritual studies, and are well-known among the tourists. Some ancient temples with beautifully carved statues are also located in the place. There are a few vegetarian food joints that serve various Ayurvedic food and refreshments. A few shops are also found, that sell various trinkets and souvenirs in the form of religious tapes, books, beads, beaded garlands, shells and clothe.

Gita Bhawan : Near the Lakshaman Jhula, is the newly constructed building of Gita Bhavan. It runs a free Ayurvedic dispensary and also has a branch of the Gita Press, Gorakhpur. There are more than a hundred rooms for visitors and this edifice houses various striking paintings and statues of ancient mythological characters. The stories of the ancient epics- the Ramayana and the Mahabharata are beautifully illustrated on its walls. The place is also popular among the tourists.

pages.body:
Kausani is a hill station and Village situated in Bageshwar district in the state of Uttarakhand, India. It is famous for its scenic splendour and its spectacular 300 km-wide panoramic view of Himalayan peaks like Trisul, Nanda Devi and Panchchuli.

Bhimtal is a town and a nagar panchayat in Nainital district in the state of Uttarakhand, India, situated at an altitude of 1370 meters above sea level and is about 22 kilometers from Nainital. The major attraction in Bhimtal is the Bhimtal Lake, which has an island at its centre

Nainital : is a Himalayan resort town in the Kumaon region of India’s Uttarakhand state, at an elevation of roughly 2,000m. Formerly a British hill station, it’s set around Nainital Lake, a popular boating site with Naina Devi Hindu Temple on its north shore. A cable car runs to Snow View observation point (at 2,270m), with vistas over the town and mountains including Nanda Devi, Uttarakhand’s highest peak.

Tour Itinerary

Day 01: Delhi – Rishikesh (230Kms / 6Hrs).

Meet at Delhi Airport/ Railway station/ Hotel & transfer to Rishikesh. Check in to your hotel at arrival in Rishikesh. Visit Tirveni Ghat for holy dip and evening Ganga Aarti. Return to your hotel. Enjoy dinner and overnight stay at Rishikesh.

Day 02: Rishikesh Adventure activity.

Morning after breakfast, enjoy adventure activity in Rishikesh. Stay overnight at Rishikesh.
Adventure Activity : White Water Rafting, Bungy Jumping, Flying Fox & Giant Swing.

Day 03: Rishikesh - Chopta (170 Kms / 7 - 8 Hrs).

Morning after breakfast, drive for Chopta. In-route visit Devprayag and Ukhimath. Check in to the guest house at Arrival. Evening we will go for a short hike to stretch our leg muscles. Later enjoy bonfire. Dinner and Overnight stay in guest house.
Devprayag : Devprayag is where Alaknanda River and Bhagirathi rivers meet and take the name Ganga or Ganges River. Here you can also visit Raghunath Temple of Lord Ram.

Ukhimath : Ukhimath is Shiva Temple where idols from Kedarnath are worshipped in winter when Kedarnath Temple is not open.

Day 04: Chopta to Tungnath Chandrashila Trek and return (8 kms drive & 5 kms trek one way).

Morning after breakfast, start your trek to Chnadrashila - Tungnath. Enjoy breathtaking views of himalayas. The climb is demanding but short and extremely scenic. It will take about a couple of hours to reach Tungnath temple. Religious or non-religious does not matter, just sit by yourself for a few minutes in the courtyard of the temple with eyes closed you will feel very light! After a brief stop for refreshments and rest carry on with your climb to reach the summit of Chandrashilla peak at about 4000m. The effort is going to be rewarded multiple times with views which are surely unparalleled. From the summit you can see big Himalayan peaks (Nanda Devi, Trishul, Chaukhamba and many more) and surrounding valleys in all directions. After capturing the views in your camera start walking down to the base camp at Chopta Later return to Chopta. Dinner and Overnight stay in guest house.

Chandrashila : Chandrashila is summit of the Tungnath. It literally means "Moon Rock". It is located at a height of about 4,000 metres (13,000 ft) above sea level. This peak provides a spectacular view of Himalayas,especially Nandadevi, Trisul, Kedar Peak, Bandarpunch and Chaukhamba peaks. There are various legends associated with this place. According to one of the popular legend, this is the place where Lord Rama meditated after defeating the demon-king Ravana.Another legend says that moon-god Chandra spent time here in penance.The Beauty of Chandrashila is Incredible.It is an impressive vantage point that offers 360 degrees panoramic views of the mighty Himalayas.This is a beautiful trek, with difficulty level rated as easy to moderate.

Tungnath : Tungnath is the highest Shiva temple in the world. The Tunganath (literal meaning: Lord of the peaks) mountains form the Mandakini and Alaknanda river valleys. Located at an altitude of 3,680 m (12,073 ft), and just below the peak of Chandrashila. The temple is believed to be 1000 years old. Temple is closed during Nov to April in winters.

Day 05: Chopta - Joshimath Via Chamoli (150 Kms / 5 - 6).

Morning after breakfast check out from hotel and drive for Joshimath . Check inn into hotel at arrival in Joshimath. Evening free for your leisure and pleasure. Dinner & overnight stay at Joshimath.

Day 06: Joshimath - Auli by Cable Car.

Mornings have breakfast at hotel and later check out then take cable car for Auli from Joshimath. Check inn into hotel on arrival at Auli. Explore Auli Lake and Enjoy Snow Skiing. Stay overnight at Auli.

Day 07: Auli.

Morning after breakfast day free for your leisure and pleasure.

Day 08: Auli - Joshimath Kausani (200 kms/ 8-9 Hrs).

Morning have breakfast at hotel and drive for Kausani. Check inn into hotel on arrival at Kausani. If time permits explore Kausani sightseeing. Stay overnight at Kausani.

Day 09: Kausani Nainital (140Kms / 3-4Hrs Drive).

Morning after breakfast, drive for Nainital. Check in into your hotel on arrival at Nainital. Stay Overnight at Nainital.

Day 10: Nainital Sightseeing.

Morning after breakfast, enjoy the sightseeing of Nainital. Visit Nainia Devi Temple, Naini Lake, Sat Tal, Bhim Tal, Naukuchital, Zoo Garden & Observatory. After Lunch visit Mall Road Market by walk. After completing Nainital sightseeing drives back to Hotel. Stay overnight at Nainital.
Note : For Nainital Sightseeing we will provide Tavera Car because big vehicle can’t enter in Nainital town.

Day 11: Nainital Delhi drop (350Kms / 8 - 9 Hrs drive).

Morning after breakfast, drive for Delhi. Dropping at Delhi Airport/ Railway Station/ Hotel.

Tour end with sweet memories

pages.body:
Rishikesh in Uttarakhand is one of the most pilgrimage centers of India. Rishikesh City is the gateway to the cities that form the Chardham - Badrinath, Kedarnath, Gangotri and Yamunotri. The name of the city is taken from Hrishikesh, which was one more name of Lord Vishnu. The sacred river Ganga flows through this state. Rishikesh is to be found on the right bank of River Ganga and bounded on 3 sides by Himalayan ranges. It is said that when Raibhya Rishi did self-mortification, God appeared by the name of "Rishikesh" and hence this region was known as by this name.

Rishikesh city is forever well-known for its Yoga centres in the worldwide, people from all over the world congregate in Rishikesh to learn lessons of yoga and meditation in this sacred place. Also this celestial place is filled with beautiful guesthouses, meditation centres, ashramas and dharmashalas.

FAQ for Rishikesh City

Q 01. What is geography of Rishikesh city?

Ans. Rishikesh city is placed at Uttarakhand on the Tehri Garhwal area. Rishikesh city lies on the banks of river Ganga and is bounded by the Himalayas. Rishikesh is located at a height of 356 m above sea level. The geographical position of Rishikesh is 30.7 North Latitude and 78.42 East. It is only 25 kilometers away from Haridwar.

Q 02. Which type of Cuisine in Rishikesh city?

Ans. People of Rishikesh city are strict vegetarians. Non-vegetarian food has been banned in the city from several years. North and south Indian cuisine is broadly offered, and there`s no shortage of multi-cuisine backpacker cafes. There are scrumptious Ayurvedic and health food restaurants that serve quality food.

Q 03. What is demography of Rishikesh city?

Ans. As per the 2001 census, Rishikesh had a population of above 59,671. Males constitute 56% of the population and females 44%. Rishikesh has an average literacy rate of 75%, higher than the national average of 59.5%. Here 80% of the males and 68% of the females are literate.

Q 04. What is Attraction in Rishikesh City?

Ans. Rishikesh city is best to wander and travel around on foot. The flowing water, chime of bell is constantly heard. Triveni bathing ghat is perfect for taking dip in Ganges River and to offer prayers. The twilight prayer is spectacular and adventure lovers can enjoy rafting and trekking opportunities.

Rishikesh city travel guide informs you about the popular places liked by tourists. Some top ashrams include Shivananda Ashram, Yoga Niketan , adventure sports like rafting, camping, trekking and many old and new temples, many yoga and meditation centers.

Q 05. What is Excursions in Rishikesh city?

Rajaji National Park : Rajaji National Park in situated 25 kms far from Rishikesh. The park is extended across the 820 sq. kms. There are 500 elephants, 12 Tigers, 250 Panthers, 400 bird species and so many animals found here. Jungle safari is also organized at the park. Best place if you are interested wildlife. During monsoon it is closed.

Vashistha Cave : Vashistha cave or Vasistha cave is beautiful cave 25 kms far from Rishikesh. Vasistha was a sage and Guru of Lord Ram. Vasistha meditated here for a long period. Small Shivlinga is also located inside the cave. Cave has very peaceful atmosphere. Not So much tourist visits here so you can easily spend some time inside the cave for meditation.

Kunjapuri Devi Temple Trek : Kunjapuri is a temple of Goddess Durga near Narendranagar (26 kms far from Rishikesh. The temple has amazing view of the snow clad Himalayan peaks. This temple is located at 1640 meter height. To reach temple you have to walk more than 350 steps. The temple is very famous among the local people.

Tribal Tour in Rishikesh (Village Tour) : Tribal tour can be done near Rajaji National Park or in Garhwal/Kumaoun villages. At Rajaji National park you can meet Gurjar Tribe which lives in their dera in small groups. This place is around 50 kms far from Rishikesh. Lunch with Gurjars at their home or Jungle visit with this tribal people can be booked in advance. Best option to know how people in remote area spend their lives. Village stay or home stay in Garhwal or Kumaoun region is also another option.

Neer Garh Waterfall (Neer Gaddu Waterfall) : Neer Garh Waterfall is also known as Neer Gaddu waterfall. This waterfall is located 3.5 kms jungle trek from Laksman Jhula. Amazing place inside the jungle if you want to spend a time with nature and just yourself. Wonderful option for half day tour.

Jhilmil Gufa (Jhilmil Cave) : Jhilmil is cave near Nilkanth Temple. Jhilmil gufa is situated 06 kms far from Nilkanth Mahadev Temple. The place is visited by only few people. The whole 02 kms trekking is inside the Jungle. At cave you can meet monks who takes care of the cave.

Haridwar : Haridwar is city near Rishikesh which is 35 kms far from Rishikesh. Minimum full day is required to visit the city properly. Haridwar Ganges ceremony (Ganga Aarti) at Har Ki Pauri is very famous in all over India. Some other splaces are Mansa Devi Temple and Chandi Devi Temple. Haridwar is one of the holiest places of Hinduism where more than 15 lakh people visit every year to take a holy bath in River Ganges.

Mussoorie : Mussoorie is hill station which is 80 kms far from Rishikesh and located at 6580 feet above from sea level. Gun Hill, Kempty fall, Company garden, landour and Lal tibba are places that you can visit. This hill town can give you tremendous views of snow clad Himalayas. Mussoorie is well known as queen of hills.

Devprayag : Devprayag is ancient town located at 75 kms far from Rishikesh. Devprayag is confluence of River Alaknanda and River Bhagirathi. After this confluence the river is known as River Ganges (Ganga). Ancient temple of Lord Ram is also famous here. The whole route (from Rishikesh to Devprayag) is hilly area and have very beautiful sceneries.

Other Places to see near Rishikesh: Dehradun, Dhanaulti, Kanatal, Chamba, Chakrata, Landown, Tehri Dam, Devoprayag, Auli, Nainital, Corbett, Ranikhet, Kausani, Kedarnath, Badrinath, Gangotri, Yamunotri, Hemkund Sahib and Valley of flowers.

Q 06. How many Yoga Ashram In Rishikesh city?

Ans.There is many types of ashram as per below:

Kailash Ashram : Kailash Ashram was started by Swami Danaraj Giri Ji Maharaj in 1880. This Ashram is well known for teachings of Hindu Philosophy Specially Advaita Vedanta in traditional way (In Hindi Language only).The Ashram is well known for their famous lecturers which are eminent in the field of teaching Hindu philosophy. There are limited rooms only for students & devotees only.

Parmarth Niketan Ashram : Parmarth Niketan Ashram is situated at the Swarg Ashram area. This ashram is started by Swami Shikdevanand Ji. The Ashram is one of the only few Ashram where still children can get Vedic education (Gurukul). Ashram is near the river Ganga & has very spiritual atmosphere. Various everyday activities are organized here. Parmarth Ashram is host for the International Yoga Festival every year. One of the most popular Ashram for yoga among the beginners. Everyday yoga classes are organized twice a day except weekends. Meditation classes are also available. Parmarth Niketan Ashram is located at Swarg Ashram area.

Sivananda Ashram : Sivananda Ashram is located near Ram Jhula. Swami Sivananda stayed here for more than 03 decades & had started this Ashram. Organization is also known as Devine Life Society. Swami Sivananda was physician in early life. He came to Rishikesh at the age of 37 years & started this ashram in small cowshed. Sivananda Ashram (Devine life society) has also everyday yoga classes except Sunday. Ashram has separate timings for men & women. Morning classes are for men & evening classes are for women. Reservation is required for classes. Two month courses are also available. Meditation Classes & Pranayam classes are also available. Sivananda Ashram is located near Ram Jhula. Ashram is specialized in Iyenger Yoga.

Dayananda Ashram : Dayananda Ashram is situated at the bank of the river Ganga. This Ashram is famous for studies of Vedanta & Sanskrit. Dayananda Ashram in unique in way of teaching because their classes are conducted in English language. Ashram was established in 1960 by Swami Dayananda Saraswati. Sadhana Mandir Ashram: Sandhana Mandir was established by Swami Rama in 1966. The Ashram is focused on meditation. Ashram is located near River Ganges in peaceful atmosphere away from the main city. Ashram has various activities related to meditation, Art of Living & other spiritual activities.

Beatles Ashram : The Beatles stayed at Maharishi Mahesh Yogi Ashram in Rishikesh. The Ashram is also known as Beatles Ashram. Ashram is closed now & under the forest Department. Still the buildings are there. Sri Ravishankar Ashram: Sri Ravishankar Ashram is located near the Dayananda Ashram. Ashram belongs to Sri Ravishankar well known for his Art of living foundation.

Omkarananda Ashram : Omkarnanda Ashram is founded by Swami Omkarnanda Saraswati. The Ashram is conducting many activities such as spiritual, educational & yoga & cultural activities. Ashram has also temples of Kamakshi Devi & Mahakala Bhairava. The Ashram is located in Sivananda Nagar (Muni Ki Reti).

Nirmal Ashram : Nirmal Ashram is located at Mayakund near Triveni Ghat. Nirmal Ashram is famous for its various services for society. Nirmal Ashram Hospital, Nirmal Ashram Eye Hospital & Nirmal Ashram Eye Institute is part of this Ashram.

Madhuban Ashram : This ashram is located at Muni ki Reti. The Ashram follows well known Iscon tradition (Vaishnav). Madhuban has very beautiful Lord Krishna Temple. Guest house is also there for stay. Annual Rath Yatra is also organized every year.

Aurovalley Ashram : Aurovalley Ashram is located is just 15 kms far from Rishikesh at Raiwala town. The Ashram has beautiful world temple. The Ashram is conducting various activities. Aurovalley school is also here for local children. People can stay here and participate in various activities (Karma Yoga).

Yog Niketan Ashram : Yog Niketan Ashram provides yoga classes during October to February. Classes are generally once in a day in morning time except weekends. Meditation Classes & Pranayam classes are also available. Yog Niketan Ashram is located near Ram Jhula.

Omkarananda Ganga Sadan Ashram : Omkarnanda Ashram is located near Muni ki Reti taxi stand. Omkarananda Ashram has Iyenger style yoga classes at their Patanjali Yoga Kendra. There are regular yoga classes at their center as per their schedule. The Ashram has their own ghat at River Ganges.

Phool Chatti Ashram : Phool Chatti Yoga Ashram is located 05 kms far from Lakshman Jhula. Yoga classes are organized in spring & autumn season. For yoga classes you must have to stay at Ashram. Phool Chatti Ashram teaches not just yoga asanas but also Ashram life. The Ashram is located near the River & has very beautiful surroundings.

Anand Prakash Ashram : Anand Prakash Yoga Ashram is located at Tapovan area (Near Lakshman Jhula). Classes are organized everyday except weekend. Ashram has special Akhanda Yoga. Ashram was founded by Yogrishi Vishvketu in 2007.

Mahatma Yoga Ashram : Mahatma Yoga Ashram is located at Lakshman Jhula. Mahatma Yoga Ashram has every day yoga classes twice a day. Mahatma Yoga Ashram is small compare to other Ashram but has yoga classes as well as meditation classes, Ayurveda Massage, Panch karma & Reiki.

Sri Ved Niketan Ashram : Sri Ved Niketan Ashram is located near Ram Jhula at Swarg Ashram area. Regular classes are organized twice a day. Ashram is just on the way from Ram Jhula to Lakshman Jhula. Meditation & Pranayam classes are also available.

Sri Sant Seva Ashram : Sri Sant Seva Ashram is located near Lakshman Jhula. This is more guest house than Ashram. Rooms are budget category. Yoga classes are as per ashram schedule.

Other Yoga Ashrams in Rishikesh : Himalayan Yoga Ashram, Swami Dayananda Ashram, Vithal Ashram, Bharat Hermitage Ashram, Sri Swami Balyogi Premvarni Ashram, Swami Ram Sadhaka Grama Ashram, Yogahut Tapovan Ashram & Kriya Yoga Ashram.

Yoga Centers in Rishikesh : Being Yoga capital of the world Rishikesh is full of various yoga centers. Local people and tourists join these centers to learn & practice yoga. Some people also take course of Yoga Teachers Training. This course helps them to become yoga teacher & later they can teach other students. Some centers also provide accommodation & meals with the course. Please check below information.

The Yoga Study Centre : The Yoga Study Centre is very famous. Yoga is conducted in Iyangar style. Students are mix of local and foreign. The teachers here are very strict for classes. The centre is closed from mid-December to mid-January and for March, May and June.

Other Ashrams in Rishikesh : Van Prastha Ashram, Sadhan Sangha Ashram, Hari Har Kailash Gyan Peeth Ashram , Bankhandi Ashram, Bhagwan Ashram, Shri Swami Narayan Ashram, Mastnath Ashram, Bharat Milap Ashram, Kripalu Yoga Ashram, Sachha Dham Ashram, Phool Chatti Ashram, Om Anand Swami Ashram, Vedanta Ashram, Bhagwan Giri Ashram.

Q 07. Which type of Music schools & classes in Rishikesh city?

Please find the below music schools & classes in Rishikesh:

Vina Maharaj Music School : Vina Maharaj Music School is situated near Ram Jhula. In the Vina Maharaja Music School concert on music is arranged on every day at late evening before dinner. faqs.question: What is geography of Rishikesh city?
faqs.answer: Rishikesh city is placed at Uttarakhand on the Tehri Garhwal area. Rishikesh city lies on the banks of river Ganga and is bounded by the Himalayas. Rishikesh is located at a height of 356 m above sea level. The geographical position of Rishikesh is 30.7 North Latitude and 78.42 East. It is only 25 kilometers away from Haridwar.

faqs.question: Which type of Cuisine in Rishikesh city?
faqs.answer: People of Rishikesh city are strict vegetarians. Non-vegetarian food has been banned in the city from several years. North and south Indian cuisine is broadly offered, and there`s no shortage of multi-cuisine backpacker cafes. There are scrumptious Ayurvedic and health food restaurants that serve quality food.

faqs.question: What is demography of Rishikesh city?
faqs.answer: As per the 2001 census, Rishikesh had a population of above 59,671. Males constitute 56% of the population and females 44%. Rishikesh has an average literacy rate of 75%, higher than the national average of 59.5%. Here 80% of the males and 68% of the females are literate.

faqs.question: What is Attraction in Rishikesh City?
faqs.answer: Rishikesh city is best to wander and travel around on foot. The flowing water, chime of bell is constantly heard. Triveni bathing ghat is perfect for taking dip in Ganges River and to offer prayers. The twilight prayer is spectacular and adventure lovers can enjoy rafting and trekking opportunities. Rishikesh city travel guide informs you about the popular places liked by tourists. Some top ashrams include Shivananda Ashram, Yoga Niketan , adventure sports like rafting, camping, trekking and many old and new temples, many yoga and meditation centers.

faqs.question: What is Excursions in Rishikesh city?
faqs.answer: Rajaji National Park : Rajaji National Park in situated 25 kms far from Rishikesh. The park is extended across the 820 sq. kms. There are 500 elephants, 12 Tigers, 250 Panthers, 400 bird species and so many animals found here. Jungle safari is also organized at the park. Best place if you are interested wildlife. During monsoon it is closed. Vashistha Cave : Vashistha cave or Vasistha cave is beautiful cave 25 kms far from Rishikesh. Vasistha was a sage and Guru of Lord Ram. Vasistha meditated here for a long period. Small Shivlinga is also located inside the cave. Cave has very peaceful atmosphere. Not So much tourist visits here so you can easily spend some time inside the cave for meditation. Kunjapuri Devi Temple Trek : Kunjapuri is a temple of Goddess Durga near Narendranagar (26 kms far from Rishikesh. The temple has amazing view of the snow clad Himalayan peaks. This temple is located at 1640 meter height. To reach temple you have to walk more than 350 steps. The temple is very famous among the local people. Tribal Tour in Rishikesh (Village Tour) : Tribal tour can be done near Rajaji National Park or in Garhwal/Kumaoun villages. At Rajaji National park you can meet Gurjar Tribe which lives in their dera in small groups. This place is around 50 kms far from Rishikesh. Lunch with Gurjars at their home or Jungle visit with this tribal people can be booked in advance. Best option to know how people in remote area spend their lives. Village stay or home stay in Garhwal or Kumaoun region is also another option. Neer Garh Waterfall (Neer Gaddu Waterfall) : Neer Garh Waterfall is also known as Neer Gaddu waterfall. This waterfall is located 3.5 kms jungle trek from Laksman Jhula. Amazing place inside the jungle if you want to spend a time with nature and just yourself. Wonderful option for half day tour. Jhilmil Gufa (Jhilmil Cave) : Jhilmil is cave near Nilkanth Temple. Jhilmil gufa is situated 06 kms far from Nilkanth Mahadev Temple. The place is visited by only few people. The whole 02 kms trekking is inside the Jungle. At cave you can meet monks who takes care of the cave. Haridwar : Haridwar is city near Rishikesh which is 35 kms far from Rishikesh. Minimum full day is required to visit the city properly. Haridwar Ganges ceremony (Ganga Aarti) at Har Ki Pauri is very famous in all over India. Some other splaces are Mansa Devi Temple and Chandi Devi Temple. Haridwar is one of the holiest places of Hinduism where more than 15 lakh people visit every year to take a holy bath in River Ganges. Mussoorie : Mussoorie is hill station which is 80 kms far from Rishikesh and located at 6580 feet above from sea level. Gun Hill, Kempty fall, Company garden, landour and Lal tibba are places that you can visit. This hill town can give you tremendous views of snow clad Himalayas. Mussoorie is well known as queen of hills. Devprayag : Devprayag is ancient town located at 75 kms far from Rishikesh. Devprayag is confluence of River Alaknanda and River Bhagirathi. After this confluence the river is known as River Ganges (Ganga). Ancient temple of Lord Ram is also famous here. The whole route (from Rishikesh to Devprayag) is hilly area and have very beautiful sceneries. Other Places to see near Rishikesh: Dehradun, Dhanaulti, Kanatal, Chamba, Chakrata, Landown, Tehri Dam, Devoprayag, Auli, Nainital, Corbett, Ranikhet, Kausani, Kedarnath, Badrinath, Gangotri, Yamunotri, Hemkund Sahib and Valley of flowers.

faqs.question: How many Yoga Ashram In Rishikesh city?
faqs.answer: There is many types of ashram as per below: Kailash Ashram : Kailash Ashram was started by Swami Danaraj Giri Ji Maharaj in 1880. This Ashram is well known for teachings of Hindu Philosophy Specially Advaita Vedanta in traditional way (In Hindi Language only).The Ashram is well known for their famous lecturers which are eminent in the field of teaching Hindu philosophy. There are limited rooms only for students & devotees only. Parmarth Niketan Ashram : Parmarth Niketan Ashram is situated at the Swarg Ashram area. This ashram is started by Swami Shikdevanand Ji. The Ashram is one of the only few Ashram where still children can get Vedic education (Gurukul). Ashram is near the river Ganga & has very spiritual atmosphere. Various everyday activities are organized here. Parmarth Ashram is host for the International Yoga Festival every year. One of the most popular Ashram for yoga among the beginners. Everyday yoga classes are organized twice a day except weekends. Meditation classes are also available. Parmarth Niketan Ashram is located at Swarg Ashram area. Sivananda Ashram : Sivananda Ashram is located near Ram Jhula. Swami Sivananda stayed here for more than 03 decades & had started this Ashram. Organization is also known as Devine Life Society. Swami Sivananda was physician in early life. He came to Rishikesh at the age of 37 years & started this ashram in small cowshed. Sivananda Ashram (Devine life society) has also everyday yoga classes except Sunday. Ashram has separate timings for men & women. Morning classes are for men & evening classes are for women. Reservation is required for classes. Two month courses are also available. Meditation Classes & Pranayam classes are also available. Sivananda Ashram is located near Ram Jhula. Ashram is specialized in Iyenger Yoga. Dayananda Ashram : Dayananda Ashram is situated at the bank of the river Ganga. This Ashram is famous for studies of Vedanta & Sanskrit. Dayananda Ashram in unique in way of teaching because their classes are conducted in English language. Ashram was established in 1960 by Swami Dayananda Saraswati. Sadhana Mandir Ashram: Sandhana Mandir was established by Swami Rama in 1966. The Ashram is focused on meditation. Ashram is located near River Ganges in peaceful atmosphere away from the main city. Ashram has various activities related to meditation, Art of Living & other spiritual activities. Beatles Ashram : The Beatles stayed at Maharishi Mahesh Yogi Ashram in Rishikesh. The Ashram is also known as Beatles Ashram. Ashram is closed now & under the forest Department. Still the buildings are there. Sri Ravishankar Ashram: Sri Ravishankar Ashram is located near the Dayananda Ashram. Ashram belongs to Sri Ravishankar well known for his Art of living foundation. Omkarananda Ashram : Omkarnanda Ashram is founded by Swami Omkarnanda Saraswati. The Ashram is conducting many activities such as spiritual, educational & yoga & cultural activities. Ashram has also temples of Kamakshi Devi & Mahakala Bhairava. The Ashram is located in Sivananda Nagar (Muni Ki Reti). Nirmal Ashram : Nirmal Ashram is located at Mayakund near Triveni Ghat. Nirmal Ashram is famous for its various services for society. Nirmal Ashram Hospital, Nirmal Ashram Eye Hospital & Nirmal Ashram Eye Institute is part of this Ashram. Madhuban Ashram : This ashram is located at Muni ki Reti. The Ashram follows well known Iscon tradition (Vaishnav). Madhuban has very beautiful Lord Krishna Temple. Guest house is also there for stay. Annual Rath Yatra is also organized every year. Aurovalley Ashram : Aurovalley Ashram is located is just 15 kms far from Rishikesh at Raiwala town. The Ashram has beautiful world temple. The Ashram is conducting various activities. Aurovalley school is also here for local children. People can stay here and participate in various activities (Karma Yoga). Yog Niketan Ashram : Yog Niketan Ashram provides yoga classes during October to February. Classes are generally once in a day in morning time except weekends. Meditation Classes & Pranayam classes are also available. Yog Niketan Ashram is located near Ram Jhula. Omkarananda Ganga Sadan Ashram : Omkarnanda Ashram is located near Muni ki Reti taxi stand. Omkarananda Ashram has Iyenger style yoga classes at their Patanjali Yoga Kendra. There are regular yoga classes at their center as per their schedule. The Ashram has their own ghat at River Ganges. Phool Chatti Ashram : Phool Chatti Yoga Ashram is located 05 kms far from Lakshman Jhula. Yoga classes are organized in spring & autumn season. For yoga classes you must have to stay at Ashram. Phool Chatti Ashram teaches not just yoga asanas but also Ashram life. The Ashram is located near the River & has very beautiful surroundings. Anand Prakash Ashram : Anand Prakash Yoga Ashram is located at Tapovan area (Near Lakshman Jhula). Classes are organized everyday except weekend. Ashram has special Akhanda Yoga. Ashram was founded by Yogrishi Vishvketu in 2007. Mahatma Yoga Ashram : Mahatma Yoga Ashram is located at Lakshman Jhula. Mahatma Yoga Ashram has every day yoga classes twice a day. Mahatma Yoga Ashram is small compare to other Ashram but has yoga classes as well as meditation classes, Ayurveda Massage, Panch karma & Reiki. Sri Ved Niketan Ashram : Sri Ved Niketan Ashram is located near Ram Jhula at Swarg Ashram area. Regular classes are organized twice a day. Ashram is just on the way from Ram Jhula to Lakshman Jhula. Meditation & Pranayam classes are also available. Sri Sant Seva Ashram : Sri Sant Seva Ashram is located near Lakshman Jhula. This is more guest house than Ashram. Rooms are budget category. Yoga classes are as per ashram schedule. Other Yoga Ashrams in Rishikesh : Himalayan Yoga Ashram, Swami Dayananda Ashram, Vithal Ashram, Bharat Hermitage Ashram, Sri Swami Balyogi Premvarni Ashram, Swami Ram Sadhaka Grama Ashram, Yogahut Tapovan Ashram & Kriya Yoga Ashram. Yoga Centers in Rishikesh : Being Yoga capital of the world Rishikesh is full of various yoga centers. Local people and tourists join these centers to learn & practice yoga. Some people also take course of Yoga Teachers Training. This course helps them to become yoga teacher & later they can teach other students. Some centers also provide accommodation & meals with the course. Please check below information. The Yoga Study Centre : The Yoga Study Centre is very famous. Yoga is conducted in Iyangar style. Students are mix of local and foreign. The teachers here are very strict for classes. The centre is closed from mid-December to mid-January and for March, May and June. Other Ashrams in Rishikesh : Van Prastha Ashram, Sadhan Sangha Ashram, Hari Har Kailash Gyan Peeth Ashram , Bankhandi Ashram, Bhagwan Ashram, Shri Swami Narayan Ashram, Mastnath Ashram, Bharat Milap Ashram, Kripalu Yoga Ashram, Sachha Dham Ashram, Phool Chatti Ashram, Om Anand Swami Ashram, Vedanta Ashram, Bhagwan Giri Ashram.

Jim Corbett : Jim Corbett National Park is a forested wildlife sanctuary in northern India’s Uttarakhand State. Rich in flora and fauna, it’s known for its Bengal tigers. Animals, including tigers, leopards and wild elephants, roam the Dhikala zone. On the banks of the Ramganga Reservoir, the Sonanadi zone is home to elephants and leopards, along with hundreds of species of birds.

Girja Devi Temple : Dedicated to Goddess Parvati, Garjia Devi temple perched atop a huge rock in the midst of Kosi River is also home to the deities of Baba Bhairon, Lord Shiva, Lord Ganesha and Goddess Saraswati.

pages.excerpt: Rishikesh with Dharamshala Tour is unique and popular tour. Rishikesh and Dharamshala is very different towns with few similarities. Dharamshala is famous for its Tibetan culture. Both town has one similarity which is scenic beauty.
pages.body:
Rishikesh with Dharamshala Tour is unique and popular tour. Rishikesh and Dharamshala is very different towns with few similarities. Rishikesh is famous for Its Yoga, Ashrams, River Ganges, Temples, Ghat and Adventure Sports Tourism. Dharamshala is famous for its Tibetan culture. Both town has one similarity which is scenic beauty.

Dharamshala Tour

Dharamshala or Dharamsala is a city in Kangra district of Himachal Pradesh in India. Dharamshala has an average elevation of 1457 metres (4780 feet), covering an area of almost 8.51 km². Earlier it was known as Bhagsu. Dharamsala is 18 Kms far from Kangra. Dharamshala is beautiful town surrounded by dense forest and scenic beauty of Kangra Valley. Due to the Tibetan people and presence of 14th Dalai Lama Dharamshala is now famous in all over the world. Apart from Tibetan people and culture one day Triund hill trek is also popular here. The Dalai Lama's home and the headquarters of the Central Tibetan Administration of the exiled Tibetan government are situated in McLeodGanj village in Dharamshala municipality. In 1959 the Dalai Lama had to escape from Tibet. The Indian Prime Minister permitted him and his followers to stay in McLeodGanj area in Upper Dharmshala. In 1960 Government-in-exile was established. Dharamshala has many monasteries. Library of Tibetan Works and Archives was started in 1970 by the Dalai Lama, Tenzin Gyatso. Library has more than 80,000 manuscripts and important things related to Tibetan, culture and history. It is one of the best places in the world to know Tibet. Dharamshala is full of various Tibetan temples monasteries, and schools. The area is also called Little Lhasa Or Dhasa (Combination of Dharamshala and Lhasa).

Rishikesh to Dharmshala

Rishikesh to Dharamshala Distance is 460 kms. Rishikesh to Dharamshala road is very beautiful road with natural surroundings. Normally Rishikesh to Dharamshala tour need more than 16 hours drive. By car it is very long journey. So many people prefer night halt somewhere between Rishikesh and Dharamshala. Normally we suggest our clients to stay at Nalagarh.

Rishikesh with Dharamshala Tour Itinerary (12 nights/13 days)

Day 01: Home - Delhi

Meet our representative at Delhi Airport / Railway Station and transfer to hotel at arrival in Delhi. Dinner and Overnight stay at Hotel.

Day 02: Delhi Sightseeing

Morning after breakfast, discover the Delhi. Morning visit the 400-years-old Jama Mosque (the largest in India) and local market. Later visit Red Fort (a UNESCO World Heritage Site). In the afternoon enjoy drive through Rashtrapati Bhawan (the President's Palace) and India Gate (a war memorial arch built in honor of Indian soldiers who lost their lives in World War –I). Explore the famous Humayun's Tomb (a UNESCO World Heritage Site) and Qutab Minar (a UNESCO World Heritage Site- the tallest brick minaret in the world, at 238 feet). Dinner and Overnight stay at the hotel.

Day 03: Delhi to Rishikesh via Haridwar (240 kms / 06 to 07 hrs drive)

Early morning after breakfast, check out from hotel and transfer to railway station for your train to Haridwar (Shatabdi Express 06:50 hrs). Meet our representative at arrival in Haridwar (11:30 hrs). (Later enjoy in Haridwar sightseeing after arrival. Haridwar is the place where people from across the India visit for pilgrimage and to take a holy dip into the holy river Ganges. Haridwar is an ancient city and it is one of the most sacred cities in India. The diverse nature of the Hindu religion has attracted foreign visitors from all around the world. Here you can closely experience India's complex culture and various Hindu rituals. Haridwar is also one of the four cities where Kumbh Mela is organized. Visit Mansa Devi Temple by cable car. After lunch visit Daksh Temple. Later visit Har Ki Pauri (Ganga Ghat) for famous Ganga Aarti, and continue your drive to Rishikesh. Check in to the hotel at arrival. Dinner and Overnight stay at the hotel.

Day 04: Rishikesh Tourism and Sightseeings

Early morning before breakfast meet yoga instructor and learn about breath awareness exercise and stretching exercises. After relax breakfast, enjoy sightseeing of Rishikesh. Rishikesh is one of the holy cities in India. Rishikesh is located in the foothills of the Himalayas. Rishikesh is gateway to the Himalayas. The spectacular River Ganga is like pert of the city. Rishikesh is a place visited by several yogis and sages. They lived and practiced hard penance here. Rishikesh is world famous as Yoga capital of the world. Visit Lakshman Jhula, Ram Jhula, Swarg Ashram, Beatles Ashram. Evening enjoy Ganga ceremony at Parmarth Niketan. Dinner and Overnight stay at the hotel.

Day 05: Rishikesh

Early morning again start your day with yoga and meditation class. Later proceed to Shivpuri town (26 kms far) for Rafting in River Ganga. Visit Vashistha cave for meditation. Vashistha was Guru of Lord Ram who meditated here. Later enjoy 18 kms Rafting and reach Rishikesh. After lunch meet Sadhus for small lecture on Hinduism. Evening meet an astrologer and have a small session to know your future. Later visit the Ghats for ceremony, dedicated to River Ganga (worshipped as a goddess). Dinner and Overnight stay at the hotel.

Day 06: Rishikesh

Early morning have routine yoga and meditation class. Later transfer to Rajaji National Park for 04 hour Jungle Safari. Rajaji National Park has total area of 820 square kms. Rajaji National Park has highest number of elephants than all other national parks of Uttarakhand. Tiger, leopard, Monkey, Barking deer, Sambar deer, Wild Boar, Antelopes such as the Nilgai and Goral are also living here. The Rajaji National Park has more than 400 bird species. Rajaji National Park offers amazing opportunity to nature lovers to enjoy the beautiful landscape and wildlife. After lunch, transfer to small village of Gujjar tribe. Have conversation with Gujjars and know their culture. Have a tea with them. Later return to Rishikesh. Dinner and Overnight stay at the hotel.

Day 07: Rishikesh to Nalagarh (290 Kms / 07 to 08 hrs drive)

Morning after breakfast, check out from hotel. Transfer to Nalagarh. Nalagarh is situated in the foothills of the Himalayas. Nalagarh offers a spectacular view of the Shivalik range of Himalayas with Sirsa River. The Nalagarh Fort is amazing piece of Mughal architecture. The Nalagarh Fort has are of 20 acres with forest land. Dinner and Overnight stay at the hotel.

Day 08: Nalagarh to Dharamshala (220Km / 06 to 07 hrs)

Morning after breakfast, check out from hotel. Transfer to Dharmshala. Dharamsala is famous for its scenic-beauty, serenity and Tibetan culture. This evening enjoy Tibetan dinner at local restaurant. Overnight stay at hotel.

Day 09: Dharamshala

Early morning attend meditation class. After breakfast proceed to city tour of Dharamsala. Visit Bagsu temple, Tibetan bazaar and Dalai Lama monasteries. Dharamshala is centre of Tibetan culture. Dalai lama's home is also situated in McloedGanj. Dharamshala is divided into lower Dharamshala and upper Dharamshala. Dinner and Overnight stay at the hotel.

Day 10: Dharamshala

Start your day with meditation. After breakfast proceed to Kangra Art Museum. This museum is treasure of the Kangra valleys arts, crafts and rich past. The museum also includes gallery of various paintings, Coins, sculptures, pottery, jewelries and anthropological items, local dresses used by local royalty, manuscripts, old carved doors are also on display. Evening free for leisure or meditation. Dinner and Overnight stay at the hotel.

Day 11: Dharamshala to Amritsar (210 Kms / 6 to 7 hours

)
Early morning after breakfast, check out from hotel. Drive towards Amritar. On arrival, check in to your hotel. Refresh yourself at hotel and take a lunch. Later proceed to Wagha Border for famous closing ceremony. The Wagah border is ceremonial border on the India–Pakistan Border. Every evening there is a ceremony called lowering of the flags. An energetic parade by the Border Security Force (B.S.F) of India and the Pakistan Rangers soldiers is organized here. Parade is slightly aggressive. The ceremony at this border post is like a barometer of the Indo-Pak relation. Dinner and Overnight stay at the hotel.

Day 12: Amritsar to Delhi (465 Kms 8 to 9 hours)

Early morning after breakfast, check out from hotel. Visit to Jalianwala bagh and famous Golden Temple in Amritsar. Gloden Temple is symbol of the Sikh people. Later transfer to Amritsar railway station for your train to Delhi (Shatabdi Express - dep. 17:00hrs). Meet our representative at Delhi railway station (23:15 hrs) and transfer to your hotel.

Day 13: Delhi to Home

Morning after breakfast, relax at hotel. Later check out from hotel and transfer to Railway station / airport.

Tour End with sweet memories.

pages.body:
Are you seeking to enjoy spirituality with Adventure Tourism? Motor Biking Tour in Rishikesh will be an overwhelmed travelling experience in the divine city that you cherish all your life. Over a decade of experience riding all over India has given us an edge in designing tours that rise above the usual destination to destination riding. Let us take you into an intoxicating mix of unseen cultures, unbelievable natural beauty, unheard myths and unimaginable experience.

Rishikesh Motor Biking Tour is special tour mostly for the people interested in culture & adventure. This tour starts from hotel / home / railway station. This tour provides opportunity to experience the Indian culture, Adventure as well as day to day life of local people. Tour needs a minimum 05 hours but still you will not get tired because the whole tour you will experience something new. The Rishikesh Motor Biking Tour contains not only visit to interesting places but it also provides opportunity to experience some interesting things such as Indian cooking classes, Yoga and meditation lessons, and adventure activities like rafting, camping, bungee jumping, flying fox, giant swing, experience of art and culture and old eras of bettels. During the Motor Biking Tour you will visit Lakshman Jhula (suspension bridge), Laxman Jhula market. 13 storey temple(trayambakeshwar temple) which is located in Laxman Jhula Tapovan Area which is also known as Muni-ki-reti(The sand of Sadhus). Then you will move to Ram Jhula another suspension bridge like Laxman Jhula this area you will experince older Ashrams life. Gita Bhawan, Parmarth Niketan, and Swarg Ashram are the oldest Ashram situated here. also you can visit Maharishi Mahesh Yogi (beatles Ashram). Later drive to Bharat Temple as heart of Rishikesh. By Motor bike you can check local shops and buy things after interesting bargaining. Last destination is Trivani Ghat where we will watch evening Ganga Ceremony which is a very famous ceremony and visited by hundreds of Indians every day. After ceremony we will arrange small "Pooja" for you with Hindu priest for you with flower offering to Holy River Ganges. Drop you at Railway station / Hotel / Home.

Type of Tour Package

This is private tour designed for 01 person. Tour normally start daily at 12:00 P.M. Advance booking is required. Guide will meet you at Rishikesh Station or at your hotel. Pick up & Drop.

Rishikesh bike tour Cost

01 Pax = 50 US $ single person (Rs.3000/- Approximately).

Places of Interest Rishikesh

Ancient Temples, Local Market, Day to Day activities of local people, Local food and Evening Ganges Ceremony.

Package Includes
English speaking guide, Motorbike, Monument fees, Mineral water, Ganga Ceremony and all entry fees.

Package Exclude
Your personal Expense .Additional activities like meeting with an astrologer, Indian Cooking Class, yoga, spa, meditation and Bettels Ashram Emtrance fee on extra payment basis .

pages.excerpt: Temples are wide-ranging in each and every place of the Rishikesh city. Temples of rishikesh are highly revered. These Temples are Most chosen sightseeing in Rishikesh Tourism.
pages.body:
Temples are wide-ranging in each and every place of the Rishikesh city. The temples of rishikesh are highly revered. Rishikesh is full of countless small, big, new and very old temples, spread in the mean streets of the city.

Rishikesh is important not only as pilgrimage spot closely linked with the Ramayana, but also as home for numerous important places of Hindu religious thought and spirituality and as a very grat Yoga hub.

Some an ancient temples in Rishikesh that attracts people from both far and near due to its significance. Some of the important temples in Rishikesh are Nilkanth Mahadeo temple, Kunjapuri temple, parmarth niketan temple, bharat mandir, geeta bhawan, tera manzil temple, rishikund tank and raghunath temple, and triveni Ghat temple.

A brief List of Temples in Rishikesh is given below

Nilkanth Mahadev Temple : Nilkanth mahadev temple is one of the very famed temples which is positioned at height of around 5500 ft. This temple is very popular in north India. As it is believed by the Hindu myths that it is the place where lord Shiva drank the 'wish' when the sea was being churned out for 'amrit' by the gods and the demons, and after drinking the throat of Lord Shiva became blue and that's why this place is named by Nilkanth mahadeo temple.

Kunjapuri Temple : Kunjapuri Temple is truly devoted to goddess durga which is the parvati next roop. Kunjapuri Temple is also consider by shaktipeeth. It is believed that lord Shiva approved all the way through this place on his manner go back to Kailash with the corpse of Sati whose dead body part cut down at the spot where the temple of Kunja Puri stands.

Parmarth Niketan Temple : Parmarth Niketan Temple is also the most well-liked temple among the all. The Niketan has a school sprint on traditional Indian style, which is designed for its great job on Hinduism. Every day in the sunset, the Arti and Hawan is organizes by the Ashram in Ganga on the Parmarth Ghat.

Bharat Mandir Rishikesh : Bharat Mandir is one of the very old temples among the all which is constructed by the Hindu famous saint Adiguru Shankracharya in 12th century. This temple is devoted to Bharat, the younger brother of Lord Ram; it is to be found in the old town next to Triveni Ghat.

Geeta Bhawan Rishikesh : Geeta Bhawan is the one more olden temple among all the domestic temples in Rishikesh. It is the Temple in which the well-known Indian epic Mahabharata and Ramayana are explains on the walls. Here people assemble to read the Ramayana jointly. The Arti which is performing at Geeta Bhawan's Ghat on River Ganga is an amazing.

Tera Manzil Temple Rishikesh : It is a multistory temple which is extremely popular among the tourists. Tera Manzil Temple is devoted to idols of Hindu God and Goddess. Here visitors always capture a superb vision of the full area from the top of the temple, and in winter the scene of sundown from this place is an unforgettable view.

Rishikund tank and Raghunath Temple Rishikesh : Rishikesh is full of numerous small and big temples. In the banks of the Chandrabhaga River there is a team of temples. Char Dham, the famous four temples club starts off this place. The Rishikund tank and Raghunath temple near the tank also present quite beautiful scenic views. Lord Ram used the tank for bathing while he was in exile. The Bharat temple named after Bharat, one of the brothers of Lord Ram.

Triveni Ghat Rishikesh : Triveni Ghat is a bathing place at a distance about 1.5 km from Rishikesh. It is measured sacred for being the confluence of three mountain streams. Pilgrims from all over the worls come here to take a dip into the holy waters.

pages.body:
Rishikesh tour packages include travel in the city of Rishikesh and cover the famous tourist spots in the city including Ashrams, temples, markets, Ganges ceremony (Ganga Aarti), rafting, camping, wildlife, waterfalls, and much more.

Rishikesh is a small city in the state Uttarakhand of northern India and enjoys a global fame as the world's capital of Yoga and Meditation. Situated at the banks of River Ganges, the city is also a gateway to the mighty Himalayas and is in possession of massive natural beauty and majesty. There are a large number of temples in this famous spiritual town. There is a legend lined with the name of the town that states that when Rishi Raibhya did penance, God appeared before him in the form of Rishikesh(God of Senses) and hence the place got its name. The Rishikesh tour packages are perfect for every kind of tourist including those looking for spiritual and peaceful surroundings and those with an adventurous spirit.

The most popular areas covered inRishikeshtour packages are Lakshman Jhula, Ram Jhula, Yoga, Meditation, Triveni Ghat, Vashisht Gufa (cave), major temples and ashrams in Rishikesh. There are India's most liked adventure sports destinations in the town. The Rishikesh tour packages are driven by a large number of other interesting vacation destinations and also give access to other Himalayan hill stations. The River Ganges flowing through Rishikesh forms a spectacular sight. In the evening the Ganga Aarti takes place while the temple bells echo in ideal synchronization. The ultimate experience of Rishikesh tour packages is truly spiritual and adventurous.

Attractions in Rishikesh Tours

Lakshman jhula, Ram Jhula, Parmarth Niketan Ashram, Triveni Ghat, Sivananda Ashram, Bharat Mandir, Trambakeshwar Temple, Lakshman Temple, Yog Niketan Ashram, Swarg Ashram, Geeta Bhawan, Vasishtha Cave, Neelkanth Temple, Neer Gaddu Waterfall, Sacha Akhileshwar Temple, Ayyapa Temple.

Bathing Ghats for Rishikesh tour

Triveni Ghat, Ram Jhula Ghat, Geeta Bhawan Ghat.

Places to visit around Rishikesh

Raja ji National Park (10 kms), Haridwar (25 kms), Kunjapuri Temple (26 kms), Vashishta Gufa (Vashistha Cave, 28 kms), Neer Gaddu Waterfall (06 kms), Jhilmil Gufa (26 kms), Piran Kaliyar (55 kms), Devprayag (90kms), Mussoorie (90 kms), Dehradun (40 kms), Chakrata (100 kms), Dhanaulti (80 kms), Kanatal (70 kms), Chamba (60 kms), Tehri Dam (90 kms), Lansdowne (175 kms), Nainital (285 kms), Corbett (260 kms), Auli (245 kms), Chardham [Badrinath (300 kms), Kedarnath (260 kms), Gangotri (235 kms), Yamunotri (245 kms)], Valley of flowers (250 kms).

Rishikesh Tour packages include a tour for a few hours or a day. If you are in the city and want to spend your day getting to know more about Rishikesh then this day tour is the best option for you.

Rishikesh Package Tours (walking)

Rishikesh package tour culture walk is a special tour for people interested in culture. This tour commences at Lakshman Jhula. This package tour in Rishikesh provides an opportunity to experience the Indian culture and the day-to-day life of local people. The tour has a duration of 5 hours minimum. The tour contains not only a visit to interesting places but also an experience of the local flavor, art, and culture of the town. While on thisRishikeshtour, you can check the local market, meet sadhus and have chats about the religion here. The last destination is Parmarth Niketan Ghat where we will watch the evening Ganga Ceremony.

Type of Rishikesh Tour Package : this is not a group tour and is for 2-4 persons. If there is a group participating in this tour, we provide more than one guide. Advance booking is required, the tour starts at around 13:30.Our guide will meet you at Railway Station, Haridwar, and will drop you at the same place after the tour.

Note : Pick up and Drop by cab is also provided on demand.

Book this tour now

Rishikesh Tour Package (sightseeing)

The full sightseeing tour covers a visit to famous and interesting places in Rishikesh. Different options are available as per your interest. The standard tour starts in the morning with a visit to Lakshman Jhula and the local market then proceeds to Saccha Akhileshwar Mahadev temple, Trimbakeshwar Temple, Geeta Bhawan, and Sivananda Ashram. The tour concludes at Parmarth Niketan or Triveni Ghat in the evening with the view of Ganges Ceremony (Ganga Arti).

Type of Rishikesh Tour Package : this is a private tour for 2-4 persons and is conducted by a dedicated cab. The guide can be provided on demand. Advance booking is required. Our guide will meet you at Haridwar Railway Station and will drop you at the same place after the tour.

Rishikesh Tour Package (Adventure)

Rishikesh is the adventure hub of North India. There are many options in this tour package including Rafting, Camping, Bungee jumping, Rock Climbing, and Kayaking.

Type of Tour Package : Private with a dedicated cab and raft. The guide is provided on demand. This tour can be done from September to June. Adventure tours are not recommended during the Monsoon.

Book this tour now

Rishikesh Tour Packages (Tribal Villages)

These tours provide an opportunity to meet tribal people around Rishikesh and understand their culture. For one-day tours, we arrange a visit to Rajaji National Park which is home to a tribe known as Gujjar. Exclusive lunch and jungle visit is also arranged.

Type of Tour Package : Private tour, with guide. Car and lunch will be provided on demand.
Time of Rishikesh Tour Package (Tribal Village) : This tour can be done throughout the year. Normally it requires 1 day and you can return to Rishikesh the same day. To visit remote areas more than 3 days are required. Stay at the villages can be arranged in this case.

Rishikesh Tour Package (Jungle Safari)

The jungle safari tours are provided at the Chilla range of Raja ji National Park located at a distance of approximately 25 km from the town. The safari is a 4-hour jeep ride covering 36 km inside the Rajaji National Park. This tour provides an opportunity to experience exquisite Indian wildlife. Elephants are the chief attraction of this ride.

Type of Tour : This is a private tour with a guide. The cab is provided on demand. The tribal visits can also be included on request.
Time of Tour Package : jungle safari is closed during the Monsoon as per government policies. Normal tour requires 5 to 7 hours. The guest returns to Rishikesh the same day.

Book this tour now

Rishikesh Tour Package (Ashram Life)

This tour is specially designed to experience ashram functions and life inside the ashrams. Each Ashram in Rishikesh is different in motive and functions. ThisRishikeshtour provides an opportunity to meet people who live in ashrams and meet important people there who know about the functioning of the ashrams. You can participate in the social activities and activities of the ashrams.

Type of Package : private tour, guide, and car will be provided on demand.
Time of Tour Package : This tour can be done throughout the year. The duration starts from 1 day to 3 months or more.

Biking or Cycling Tours

This is an adventure tour. A standard biking or cycling tour needs 8 to 10 hours. The guide will take you to the nearby village or jungle area on a small ride. Exclusive picnic lunch will be provided in natural surroundings. The tour provides an opportunity to experience village life and the picturesque area around the town.

Type of Tour Package : This is a private tour with a guide. Biking or cycling tour is also available forRishikeshcity area. The bikes and cycles are also available for rent.
Time of Package : This tour is available throughout the year. Duration is of about 8 to 10 hours and the guest can return to Rishikesh the same day.

Book this tour now

Rishikesh Tour Package (Trekking)

One-day trekking tours are also possible at Rishikesh. There are several trekking tours available near the town where you can enjoy trekking and return on the same day. There are one-day treks near Neer Gaddu Waterfall and Kunjapuri Trek near Rishikesh.

Type of Tour Package : this is a private tour with guide.
Time of Tour : This tour can be done throughout the year. Normal duration of the tour is of around 8 to 10 hours. The guest will return toRishikeshthe same day.

Rishikesh Tour Package (Mussoorie Sightseeing)

Mussoorie is located at a distance of just 80 km from Rishikesh. Dehradun is on the way to Mussoorie. The tour starts at 9:00 AM. This tour includes a visit to Sahastradhara, Prakasheshwar Mahadev Temple, Mussoorie Lake, Kempty Fall and Company Garden (Mussoorie). In the afternoon the stop is at Mall Road from where Gun Hill can be visited by a cable car. In the evening we return to Rishikesh.

Type of Tour Package : This is a private tour conducted by a dedicated cab. Guide can be provided on demand.
Time of Tour : This tour is available throughout the year. Normally it requires 10-12 hours.

pages.body:
Rishikesh Tourism - Rishikesh Tourism Guide - Rishikesh Tours

Since times immemorial, the state of Uttarakhand has been referred to as "The Abode of Gods and Goddesses". Placed near the Himalayas, Tourism in Rishikesh has been measured as one of the major blessed pilgrimage destinations since very old times. Rishikesh Tour Packages or Rishikesh Tourism is a fair helpline to help you in deciding about the correct time and place to visit in Rishikesh. It is a place that is just beyond superiority. The holy destination offers demanding adventurous opportunities, particularly river rafting. Rishikesh tourism exposes you to the most thrilling and bold adventure sport of this place, the river rafting in the Ganges. The Haridwar Rishikesh Tourism offers you an opening to experience the quietness and peace of mind that the place has to offer.

There are lots of holy temples and ashrams to visit in Rishikesh. Rishikesh Tourism offers you a opportunity to visit the well-known ashrams including Yoga Niketan Ashram, Vanprastha Ashram, Beatles Ashram, Omkaranand Ashram, Sivanand Ashram, Swarg Ashram and Parmarth Niketan Ashram. You can as well visit the famed Bharat Mandir, which draws lots of tourists from across the countrywide. The Rishikesh Tourism also provides an uncomplicated path to visit other holy pilgrimages like Badrinath, Kedarnath, Gangotri, and Yamunotri. The scenic and tranquil attractiveness of this place is just spectacular and amazing. The Rajaji National Park, which is to be found at the basin of the Ganges, is another well-known tourist attraction of this place.

Besides these all features, Rishikesh is considered as Adventures capital of India. There are so many adventure tourism activities to do in Rishikesh, which are special things to do for making your holiday memorable. You can do Rafting and camping, Bungee Jumping, Rock climbing, flying fox, paragliding, wildlife tour, and jeep safari or elephant safari in Rajaji National Park - Rishikesh, trekking, and much more.
